detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Time sync NTP on Asterisk host and Splunk indexer.
• `TIME_FORMAT` in props if timestamps are non-standard.

Step 1 — Tune rex for your distro’s log format.

Step 2 — Exclude known maintenance windows.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare calculated buckets with the MES shift report or historian (for example PI or Proficy) for the same line and period. Confirm planned versus run time matches the routing master used by production.

Step 4 — Document carrier escalation when trunk-side.

Step 1 — Configure data collection

Install and configure the add-on referenced in the app field (Asterisk full log forwarding via Universal Forwarder, optional FreePBX `full` log path `/var/log/asterisk/full` — Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617)). Enable the modular input or HEC token that writes sourcetype=asterisk:full, asterisk:pjsip into voip. Default poll interval 300–900 seconds unless the vendor API rate-limits lower. Grant the ingestion role `list_inputs` and `search` on the target index.

Step 2 — Create the search and alert

Schedule the SPL with earliest=-24h@h and throttle per entity to avoid duplicate pages. Document tunable macros in the comment header. Understanding this SPL: filters in the first pipeline reduce license cost; stats/timechart aggregates define the alert grain; joins/lookups enrich owner or asset metadata for routing.

Step 3 — Validate

Compare `| tstats count where index=... sourcetype=...` against the vendor admin UI inventory count (+/-5%). Spot-check two known entities for field presence (`_time, endpoint, host, state_events`). Run `timechart count span=1h` over 7 days to find ingestion gaps longer than two poll intervals.

Step 4 — Operationalize

Add a dashboard row with single-value KPI tiles, a 24-hour timechart, and a drilldown table mirroring the SPL output columns. Route critical severity to the platform on-call channel; route warning to the service owner from the lookup.

Step 5 — Troubleshooting

No events: verify forwarder connectivity, HEC token ACLs, and that the modular input appears in `index=_internal source=*splunkd*`. NULL fields: check props/transforms order and TA version. Fewer results than expected: confirm index allow-lists on the search head role and that `_time` uses the correct timezone. API errors: inspect splunkd.log for HTTP 401/429 from the vendor endpoint configured in inputs.conf.
grandmaExplanation: We watch phone extension registration flaps. We help you catch flaky endpoints before calls drop in bulk.
